body.statement:
On every successful normalized-shape fit,
\[
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}|a_{stik}|
\le\{L_{sk}e_0^\top G_{sk}^{-1}e_0\}^{1/2}
\le c_G^{-1/2}.
\]
Because the weights and covariates do not depend on the replicated-unit index,
\[
\sum_t|a_{stik}|\le\frac{c_G^{-1/2}}{n_s},
\qquad
\sum_t|\bar a_{sti}|\le\frac{c_G^{-1/2}}{n_s},
\]
and hence
\[
\sum_{s=1}^{S}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}
\left[\pi_s\sum_t|\bar a_{sti}|\right]^2
\le c_G^{-1}R_{\mathrm{tr}}.
\]
The exact Taylor bias is bounded by \(A_L\).  These conclusions are deterministic on successful fits and require no upper local-mass event.
body.proof_tex:
Suppress \((s,k)\), write \(\mathsf L=L_{sk}\), \(G=G_{sk}\), and set
\(v_{ti}=w_{stk}^{1/2}b_r(u_{stk})\).  Then
\[
G=\sum_{t,i}v_{ti}v_{ti}^\top,
\qquad
a_{stik}=w_{stk}^{1/2}e_0^\top G^{-1}v_{ti}.
\]
Cauchy--Schwarz yields
\[
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{t,i}|a_{stik}|
&\le
\left\{\sum_{t,i}(e_0^\top G^{-1}v_{ti})^2\right\}^{1/2}
\left\{\sum_{t,i}w_{stk}\right\}^{1/2}\\
&=\{e_0^\top G^{-1}GG^{-1}e_0\}^{1/2}\mathsf L^{1/2}
=\{\mathsf Le_0^\top G^{-1}e_0\}^{1/2}.
\end{aligned}
\]
The selector requires \(G/\mathsf L\succeq c_GI\), so
\(G^{-1}\preceq(c_G\mathsf L)^{-1}I\).  Under the declared monomial normalization \(e_0=b_r(0)\) is the constant-monomial coordinate and \(\|e_0\|_2=1\).  Hence
\[
\mathsf Le_0^\top G^{-1}e_0\le c_G^{-1}.
\]
For fixed \((s,t,k)\), neither \(u_{stk}\) nor \(w_{stk}\) depends on \(i\), whereas
\[
G=n_s\sum_tw_{stk}b_r(u_{stk})b_r(u_{stk})^\top.
\]
Thus \(a_{stik}\) is constant in \(i\), and
\[
n_s\sum_t|a_{stik}|=\sum_{t,i}|a_{stik}|
\le c_G^{-1/2}.
\]
The triangle inequality after averaging the fixed donor folds gives the same bound for \(\bar a_{sti}\).  Therefore
\[
\sum_{s,i}\left[\pi_s\sum_t|\bar a_{sti}|\right]^2
\le\sum_sn_s\left(\frac{\pi_sc_G^{-1/2}}{n_s}\right)^2
=c_G^{-1}\sum_s\frac{\pi_s^2}{n_s}
=c_G^{-1}R_{\mathrm{tr}}.
\]
Finally, the normal equations reproduce every polynomial of total degree at most \(r\).  Subtracting the degree-\(r\) Taylor polynomial of \(m_s\) at \(\widetilde z_{sk}\), applying
\[
|m_s(x)-T_{r,\widetilde z_{sk}}m_s(x)|
\le C_{r,d}L\|x-\widetilde z_{sk}\|_2^\lambda,
\]
and summing the absolute weighted remainders gives exactly \(A_L\).  No upper bound on \(L_{sk}\) was used.
body.justification: The normalized Gram-shape rule yields the exact deterministic cluster-weight bound needed by both risk and interval proofs.
body.gap: No upper local-mass event is assumed or hidden in the selector.
body.consumer: Historical noise is controlled at the replicated-unit rate even when the number of nearby calendar sites is small.
